enablement_gate: Optimized execution may become default only after direct and deduplicated execution produce identical normalized scientific task-table SHA-256 and identical final science SHA-256 on the frozen corpus.
formal_equivalence: For every scientific task t, DirectEvaluate(t) must equal Expand(EvaluateKernel(K(t)), metadata(t)) byte-for-byte after canonical normalization.
purpose: Separate preregistered scientific task identity from deterministic computational kernel identity so exact duplicate kernels are evaluated once while every registered scientific task row is still emitted.
resume_rule: Reuse only completed matching kernels; rerun incomplete kernels; reject mismatching checkpoints; certify only after a complete deterministic task table is rebuilt.
scientific_task_rule: Every preregistered task remains present in the final normalized scientific task table.
